d:
"Rediscover the haunting melody of 'Jo Bhi Kasmein Khai Thi Humne' from the thriller 'Raaz.' Featuring Bipasha Basu and Dino Morea, and beautifully sung by Udit Narayan and Alka Yagnik, this Hindi song will captivate your heart and soul. Dive into the mystery and romance! "
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Alka Yagnik & Udit Narayan
Music Director: Nadeem - Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer
Movie Cast & Crew:
Producer: Tips Films & Mahesh Bhatt
Director: Vikram Bhatt
